detaileddescription.para:
Preallocate M_NUM_CIRCULAR_BUFFER_VECTORS receive buffers, each with a size of maxUdpRxPacketSizeBytes. If the engine is configured for more than one packet per system call, initialize the batch sender instance passing LtpUdpEngine::OnSentPacketsCallback as the send callback.

Our managed UDP socket, typically supplied by the associated LtpUdpEngineManager.
engineIndexForEncodingIntoRandomSessionNumber
The engine index.
remoteEndpoint
The remote UDP endpoint.
maxUdpRxPacketSizeBytes
The maximum UDP packet size in bytes.
ltpRxOrTxCfg
The engine config.
Initiate an engine reset (thread-safe).
Initiates an asynchronous call to LtpUdpEngine::Reset() to perform a reset. The calling thread blocks until the request is resolved.
Perform engine reset.
Calls LtpEngine::Reset() to reset the underlying LTP engine, then clear tracked stats.

If the receive buffers are full, the packet is dropped. Else, swaps in the packet to the receive buffer and calls LtpEngine::PacketIn_ThreadSafe() to forward to the underlying LtpEngine for processing. packetIn_thenSwappedForAnotherSameSizeVector holds the entire receive buffer, only the first 'size' bytes belong in the current packet and are therefore safe to read, any bytes that follow may contain partial data from previously processed packets and should be treated as garbage values.
packetIn_thenSwappedForAnotherSameSizeVector
The packet to transmit.
size
The size of the packet.
The argument to packetIn_thenSwappedForAnotherSameSizeVector is swapped with a potentially dirty buffer of an already-processed packet and is ready to be reused as the receive buffer for the next read operation (see above how to handle dirty buffers).
